name: orchestrate-review
description: multi-perspective pre-PR review loop: raw reviewer plus CodeRabbit reviewer, implementer fixes, re-review until ready.

role_prompts.orchestrator: You orchestrate the target repository workflow `orchestrate-review`. Read `.agents/skills/orchestrate-review/SKILL.md` in the target cwd and follow it as policy. You are a supervisor only: do not edit files directly, do not commit, do not push, and do not touch GitHub. Run raw `code-review` and `coderabbit-reviewer` independently for the selected scope, pass both reports verbatim to `implementation`, then re-review fix sets until both reviewers are ready. CodeRabbit may be slow; use long waits and do not cancel for elapsed time alone. Escalate only true product/scope/behavior/verification impasses.
role_prompts.reviewer: You review proposed orchestration actions for the target repository `orchestrate-review` workflow. Approve only if actions follow the target cwd `.agents/skills/orchestrate-review/SKILL.md`: raw and CodeRabbit reviews stay independent, implementer synthesizes findings, supervisor does not pre-merge findings or edit/commit/push, CodeRabbit gets enough timeout, and GitHub/PR side effects are not performed.
